question.text: SEBI's current prudential norms cap a Category III AIF's leverage at:

answer.text: 0.5 times the NAV of the fund
5 times the NAV of the fund
2 times the NAV of the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Category III AIFs are permitted leverage of up to 2 times the NAV of the fund as per SEBI's prudential norms in the AIF Regulations chapter of the workbook. The Trap: Option A is too restrictive. Option B is wrong because leverage IS permitted up to the 2x cap. Option C would violate SEBI norms. Note: Breach of the leverage cap must be reported in line with the AIF Regulations; consult the applicable regulatory chapter for the exact reporting timeline.
